name: snowflake-cli
description: Teaches Claude Code to use the Snowflake CLI (`snow`) — primarily to execute SQL and deploy DDL against Snowflake, plus a full reference of the command tree (connection, object, stage, snowpark, streamlit, app, spcs, cortex, dbt, and more), each mirroring `snow --help` with pointers to the official docs. Entry point: /prime-snow-cli.
